# openai_external_storage (Resource)

Registers customer-managed storage for a project, so that OpenAI stores the project's data in your own cloud storage. Creating it validates the configuration and only succeeds once OpenAI reports it as `validated`; otherwise the configuration is deleted again and OpenAI's error is returned. The API does not support updates, so changing any argument replaces the configuration.

~> **Warning:** Deleting a project's last external storage configuration switches the project back to the organization's default data retention. Data already written to your storage is not deleted.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openai_project" "example" {
  name = "Example Project"
}

# Store the project's data in a Google Cloud Storage bucket. Use `aws`, `azure` or `oci`
# instead for the other clouds.
resource "openai_external_storage" "example" {
  project_id = openai_project.example.id

  gcp = {
    bucket                           = "example-openai-data"
    workload_identity_project_number = "123456789012"
    workload_identity_pool_id        = "openai-pool"
    workload_identity_provider_id    = "openai-provider"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project whose data is stored.

### Optional

- `aws` (Attributes) Amazon S3 storage. Exactly one of `aws`, `azure`, `gcp` or `oci` must be set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--aws))
- `azure` (Attributes) Azure Blob Storage. Exactly one of `aws`, `azure`, `gcp` or `oci` must be set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--azure))
- `gcp` (Attributes) Google Cloud Storage, accessed through Workload Identity Federation. Exactly one of `aws`, `azure`, `gcp` or `oci` must be set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--gcp))
- `oci` (Attributes) Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Object Storage. Exactly one of `aws`, `azure`, `gcp` or `oci` must be set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--oci))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (Number) The Unix timestamp (in seconds) of when the configuration was created.
- `geography` (String) The data residency geography of the configuration.
- `id` (String) The ID of the external storage configuration.
- `status` (String) The health of the configuration: `pending`, `validated`, `degraded` or `unhealthy`. A configuration that becomes `degraded` or `unhealthy` after creation is reported here and does not fail a refresh.

<a id="nestedatt--aws"></a>
### Nested Schema for `aws`

Required:

- `bucket` (String) The S3 bucket name.
- `role_arn` (String) The ARN of the IAM role OpenAI assumes to access the bucket.

Read-Only:

- `account_id` (String) The AWS account ID that owns the role, derived by OpenAI.
- `external_id` (String) The external ID OpenAI presents when assuming the role, generated by OpenAI.
- `region` (String) The region of the bucket, derived by OpenAI.


<a id="nestedatt--azure"></a>
### Nested Schema for `azure`

Required:

- `account_name` (String) The storage account name.
- `container` (String) The blob container name.
- `resource_group` (String) The resource group of the storage account.
- `subscription_id` (String) The Azure subscription ID.
- `tenant_id` (String) The Microsoft Entra tenant ID.

Read-Only:

- `region` (String) The region of the storage account, derived by OpenAI.


<a id="nestedatt--gcp"></a>
### Nested Schema for `gcp`

Required:

- `bucket` (String) The Cloud Storage bucket name.
- `workload_identity_pool_id` (String) The ID of the Workload Identity pool.
- `workload_identity_project_number` (String) The number of the Google Cloud project that holds the Workload Identity pool.
- `workload_identity_provider_id` (String) The ID of the Workload Identity provider registered for OpenAI.

Read-Only:

- `audience` (String) The audience OpenAI uses when exchanging tokens with the Workload Identity provider: the OpenAI project ID. Add it to the provider's allowed audiences.
- `region` (String) The location of the bucket, derived by OpenAI.


<a id="nestedatt--oci"></a>
### Nested Schema for `oci`

Required:

- `bucket` (String) The Object Storage bucket name.
- `region` (String) The region of the bucket.
- `tenancy_ocid` (String) The OCID of the tenancy.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing external storage configuration
terraform import openai_external_storage.example <external_storage_id>

# Example
terraform import openai_external_storage.example extstorage_000000000000000000000000
```
